title: finding(types): StrictAnyComponentSchema refuses every metric-card widget that carries value, its required registration input — both strict arms report value as unrecognized (exported, dormant)
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11020 (`Fixes #9256`). Its at-tier contract review `5877269394` (③, out-of-scope finding 3) measured this and said it "deserves a filed carrier rather than none". ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## The defect

`StrictAnyComponentSchema`, an exported face of `@object-ui/types/zod`, refuses every `metric-card` dashboard widget that carries `value`. `value` is `metric-card`'s required registration input.
- Both strict arms of the widget-slot union report `value` as an unrecognized key: the derived strict slot arm closes the passthrough whose members are the card's registry inputs.
- `{ type: 'metric-card' }` alone parses.
- Measured by the dev (report `5876936205` on objectui#9256) at objectui `5d689c3f6` and at PR objectui#11020's head. The review probed it again at that head.

It is pre-existing: PR objectui#11020 does not cause it.

## Reach

The strict face has no non-test consumer in this repository today, so no shipped path is broken. It is exported, though, so a downstream author who validates with it gets a refusal for a correctly authored dashboard.

## Related observation, recorded at the same review (⛔ not necessarily this card's)

A node inside the legacy dashboard widget envelope `{ id, component, layout }` still parses with `children`. `DashboardWidgetSchema.component` is plain `BaseSchema`, by design (the objectui#8344 note on that member).
- The review measured it parsing green at PR objectui#11020's head for `metric-card`, `record:details` and `markdown`.
- It is therefore one pre-existing hatch around every family-D refusal (objectui#9256). It is not a face carrying any narrowed literal, so the review judged it rightly outside objectui#9256.
- The review suggested recording it with whatever owns the widget slot's routing: the objectstack#8593 ruling declined the `AnyComponentSchema` redirect there.

Whether it joins this card is triage's call.

Dedupe words: StrictAnyComponentSchema metric-card value unrecognized, strict widget slot arm passthrough closed, legacy widget envelope component BaseSchema children hatch, objectui#8344.
